title: mischief.finding/v1 — profile finding document
description: The finding document the profile executor writes to stdout (--json) and to <run_dir>/finding.json (internal/profile/finding.go, FindingSchemaV1 = mischief.finding/v1 in internal/profile/profile.go). It is the whole contract with the agent on the other end: which profile ran, on which resolved target, which fault, the independent landing witness, the probe's expected-vs-observed pair, the graded outcome, the cause class + steering hint when one applies, and the command that reproduces the run. Every field is either measured or deliberately empty — the document never carries a value the run did not observe. The three-value outcome vocabulary is closed: passed, failed, inconclusive. There is no 'ok', no 'reverted', no fourth value. Schema note: the run target is reported as the resolved selector (kind, selector, scratch path) — the document does not carry a target id or sha identity of its own.

schema.description: The finding document schema token. A schema token exists so a future shape cannot be read as if it were this one.

run_dir.description: Where the journal and the injection log live. Required.

seed.description: The seed the run used (declared or overridden). Required.

target.description: The resolved target, exactly as the run resolved it. Required.

requires.description: Optional. Every declared requirement's resolution; an UNMET requirement makes the run inconclusive, never a pass.

steps.description: Required (may be empty). One entry per profile step, in profile order. An empty set is inconclusive at the run level — a run that graded nothing proves nothing.

outcome.description: The run's graded outcome — the worst of its steps: any failed, else any inconclusive, else passed. Required.

cause_class.description: The run-level failure class, lifted from the first failed step (failed runs only). Optional; absent on passed and inconclusive runs.

hint.description: The run-level steering hint for the cause class (failed runs only). Optional.

reason.description: Names why the run is inconclusive (inconclusive runs only). Optional.

notes.description: Honest disclosures about this build's posture for the run (unmet-by-bypass rails, executor-local scenario). Optional; never empty when the executor deviates from a declared rail.

finished_at.description: The run's RFC3339 close time. Required.

reproduce.description: Required. The exact command that re-runs this profile, seed and target — the field an agent pastes into its next loop iteration.

cause_class.description: CLOSED cause_class vocabulary. This is the value a failed step routes to; the run-level finding lifts the first failed step's class. The vocabulary is closed per profile: a profile may only route failures to classes declared in its own cause_classes block, and a step naming an undeclared class is refused at load by referential integrity (internal/profile/profile.go Parse). The vocabulary shipped by this build's catalog (catalog/profiles) is exactly the per-class sets the shipped profiles declare — storage:silent-short-write (storage); durability:storage-ack-not-durable (database); auth:expired-secret-trusted / auth:indefinite-wait / auth:stale-token-accepted (auth); batch:lost-ack-on-crash / batch:mis-scheduled-after-jump / batch:silent-epipe-drop / batch:silent-partial-ingest / batch:unbounded-sink-retry (batch); mobile:empty-cold-state-mishandled / mobile:hang-on-network-loss / mobile:partial-message-accepted / mobile:silent-lost-queue / mobile:unbounded-retry (mobile); serverless:deadline-drift / serverless:duplicate-side-effect / serverless:silent-oom (serverless). Any other value is rejected by this schema — a finding must never introduce a class its profile did not declare, and the schema exists so a future revision of the finding document cannot quietly widen the vocabulary. The internal/profile schema test derives this same vocabulary from the shipped corpus and proves the two agree.

selector.description: The selector exactly as the operator wrote it. Required.

path.description: The file path the selector names — the scratch path a scratch:<path> selector points at, or the database file a dbdurability:<fsync|none>:<path> selector points at (absent for kinds that name no path). Optional.

id.description: The primitive id ("S-004"). Required; empty when the step's fault reference did not resolve.

name.description: The primitive's declared short name. Required.

backend.description: The primitive's declared injection backend ("shim"). Required.

tier.description: The primitive's declared tier string verbatim ("L1"). It is REPORTED, not enforced. Required.

params.description: The effective param set — the step's params with defaults filled by the actuator where the descriptor declares none. Optional; flat string scalars only.

kind.description: external = an independent observation (the parent process reading the target after the child exited); injector = injector-owned evidence (the shim's own counter). A witness whose only source is injector-owned evidence must say so — the anti-gaming shape. Required.

source.description: Where the observation came from. Required.

evidence.description: The measured line a reviewer can check (paths, counts, sizes). Required.

passed.description: True only when observed satisfies expected. Required.

declared.description: The profile's own prose for it. Optional.

met.description: True when the host satisfies it. Required.

detail.description: The measurement ("cc -> /usr/bin/cc") or the reason it failed. Required.

fault.description: The resolved fault; its fields are empty when the reference did not resolve (reason then says so). Required (object present even when unsubstantiated).

injected_at.description: The RFC3339 time the step's fault was armed. Optional; absent when the step never reached arming.

landed.description: True only when a landing witness was measured. Required.

landed_witness.description: The measured landing proof. Optional; absent when not landed, and a landed:false step MUST NOT carry one.

probe.description: The step's probe grading. Optional; absent when the step never graded.

detached.description: The measured inverse proof — the fault is gone. Optional; absent when the inverse was not proven.

outcome.description: The graded three-value outcome for this step. Required.

cause_class.description: The profile's declared failure class. Optional; only on failed steps, and only a class the profile declares.

hint.description: The profiling steering hint for that class. Optional; only on failed steps.

reason.description: Names why the step did not grade pass/fail (inconclusive only). Optional.

duration_ms.description: The wall time the step took. Required.
